method: Manual claim-level source audit plus literal returned-value/hash checks. Unsupported count is a listed-claim count, not a calibrated rate or exhaustive clinical adjudication.

patient_outputs.text: The pain is just in my chest; it doesn't seem to be moving to my neck, back, or arms. I am feeling short of breath and quite lightheaded. Regarding my heart history, I have end-stage renal disease and receive hemodialysis. I also had a drug-eluting stent put in for stable angina some time ago, and I have a leadless pacemaker. I don't know anything else about my heart function.

I'm sorry, I don't remember the exact time the chest pain started, it just happened while I was here getting treated for this bloodstream infection. I’m not sure about fevers, chills, or night sweats, I’d have to check with the nurses. As for my dialysis access, I don't know the specifics of that status. I'm just focused on how poorly I'm feeling right now.

I’ve been feeling this way for about two weeks, starting after I had some respiratory infection symptoms. It has gotten worse over that time. I have ulcerative colitis, which is controlled with mesalazine, and that is the only medication I take regularly. I haven't had any chest pain or dizziness since this all started.

I don't remember if I had a fever or body aches back then. I don't have a history of heart conditions, and I am not aware of any family history of sudden cardiac issues. I haven't traveled recently, and I don't know if anyone else I've been around has had similar symptoms.

I don't remember when I first started taking mesalazine, but my dose hasn't changed recently. As for previous ECGs, I don't know or I don't recall anything about my pulse or P waves being mentioned to me.
